name: fisherman
asked: A middle-aged fisherman in a yellow raincoat, green waders and a floppy tan bucket hat, with a gray beard.

accessories.name: bucket hat
accessories.description: Big floppy tan bucket hat with a wide drooping brim, a darker brown band, oversized so it is clearly visible from far away

accessories.name: gray beard
accessories.description: Thick bushy gray beard covering chin and cheeks, chunky blocky shape, light gray with white streaks, extends well below the chin

accessories.name: fishing rod
accessories.description: Long fishing rod with a thick dark brown handle, bright red reel, thin line with a red and white bobber and a curved tip, held upward

accessories.name: fish bucket
accessories.description: Bright blue bucket hanging at the hip with a silver fish tail sticking out of the top
